title: Sensors
current_gap: RGB and depth-generated point cloud have accepted bounded slices, but base-sensor calibration/noise/latency, scanning LiDAR, segmentation and a live sensor-to-consumer loop are not accepted.

atoms.name: base_sensor_truth_feed
atoms.required: Owned truth-level IMU/baro/mag/GNSS feed with sensor identity, units, frame and authoritative time to each supported stack

atoms.name: calibration_noise_latency
atoms.required: Per-sensor calibration identity plus explicit noise/bias/latency model, source and budget; a truth feed is not a calibrated sensor

atoms.name: rgb_camera
atoms.required: Timed calibrated RGB capture with epoch/step identity, mount extrinsics and current-generation delivery; accepted bounded slice under #30

atoms.name: depth_pointcloud
atoms.required: Depth capture with max-depth semantics and indexed ENU point-cloud export; accepted bounded slice under #31

atoms.name: prometheus_perception_input
atoms.required: Prometheus-format perception output from a live sensor loop; the offline ArUco seam is interface evidence only

atoms.name: extended_sensor_capabilities
atoms.required: Scanning LiDAR, segmentation and remaining image/point-cloud capabilities with owned source and per-capability contracts

scope_rule: a display or render artifact is not simulated sensor data; a truth-level feed is not a calibrated sensor

followups.blocked_by: Frozen per-sensor calibration/noise/latency budget and source
